Tape the various areas shown in the diagram using masking tape.

Road test the vehicle letting it gradually reach the speed where the noise appears: if the noise persists, carry out the preliminary location test on the entire vehicle (see 70 ).

Remove the masking tape from zone A and repeat the road test: if the noise persists, adjust the door hinges (see Op. 7010A14 ). Remove the shims from the upper hinge or add shims to the lower hinge so that the door adheres better to the seal.

Remove the masking tape from zone B and repeat the road test: if the noise persists, adjust the door hinges (see Op. 7010A14 ). Remove or add shims for the two hinges, so that the door adheres better to the seal.

Remove the masking tape from zone C and repeat the road test; if the noise persists, check the condition of the rear handle and, in particular, the presence of the seal around the lever (see Op. 7010C11 ).

Remove the masking tape from zone D and repeat the road test: if the noise persists, check the condition of the door housing seal in that area and that it adheres correctly to the bodyshell (see Op. 7010A34 ); also check that the window seal is correctly matched (with the window closed).

Remove the masking tape from zone E and repeat the road test: if the noise persists, check the condition of the glass scraper (see Op. 7010D26 ).
